t: The Union of South Africa became a republic on 31 May 1961 and left the Commonwealth under Hendrik Verwoerd.
For three decades it enforced grand apartheid, created ethnic homelands and fought a border war in Namibia and Angola.
Negotiations from 1990 led to the 1994 elections, Nelson Mandela’s presidency and the democratic constitution of 1996.
dyk: South Africa built six nuclear weapons in the 1980s and dismantled them around 1990–1991, the first country to give up a nuclear arsenal it had developed itself.
ev: The Union becomes the Republic of South Africa and leaves the Commonwealth
Nelson Mandela is sentenced to life imprisonment at the end of the Rivonia Trial
Police fire on protesting students in Soweto, setting off a national uprising
F. W. de Klerk unbans the ANC; Mandela is released after 27 years in prison
The first democratic elections make Nelson Mandela president
A new constitution with a Bill of Rights is adopted
Police kill 34 striking miners at Marikana
The ANC loses its majority and forms a Government of National Unity

f.founder: Hendrik Verwoerd (prime minister at its proclamation)
